1.consolidated_definition: Actualmente, en este momento. Expresión que significa ‘ahora’. Desvío semántico, usual. DRAE 2001: al instante, sin dilación, inmediatamente. Las tres obras que Dwayne exhibirá son “El Rey Sostuvo su Corona”, “Estoy Contigo” y una tercera que será develada en esa ocasión en la rotonda de la Casa Blanca. Pero, al momento, continúa exhibiendo de forma simultánea sus pinturas “Que No Acabe el Amor”, en el Restaurante Baires; “Corpus”, en la Galería Mi Tierra; y “Oda en Lápiz”, en el Teatro Braulio Castillo, en Bayamón
1.en_consolidated_definition:
Currently, at this moment. Expression meaning 'now'. Semantic deviation, common usage. DRAE 2001: at the instant, without delay, immediately.

The three works that Dwayne will exhibit are "The King Held His Crown", "I Am with You" and a third one that will be unveiled on that occasion in the rotonda of the White House. However, at the moment, he continues to exhibit his paintings simultaneously, "May Love Not End" at the Baires Restaurant; "Corpus" at the Mi Tierra Gallery; and "Ode in Pencil", at the Braulio Castillo Theater, in Bayamón
